title: [EPIC] Auth + Invite + Membership
body:
Outcome: secure trainer/student onboarding via invite links with auditable group membership.

DoD:
- Trainer signup/login works
- Invite create/revoke works
- Student join via invite works
- Membership/audit events stored

title: [EPIC] Reports + Media Uploads
body:
Outcome: student can submit training report with execution facts and photo attachment.

DoD:
- Report submit is idempotent
- Photo upload to private storage works
- Access to attachments is signed and scoped

title: [EPIC] Triggers + Attention Queue + Program Evaluation
body:
Outcome: trainer sees explainable active risks and basic assignment quality signals.

DoD:
- 3 triggers active (no_report_7d, two_skipped_in_row, wellbeing_low_n_times)
- Attention queue supports resolve with note
- Program evaluation screen shows adherence and plan-vs-actual trend

title: [TASK] Boot monorepo + docker-compose baseline
body: Create apps/web, apps/api, apps/worker, infra/docker and local compose for postgres/redis/minio.

title: [TASK] Implement invite token hashing + TTL + one-time use
body: Add secure invite model and validation endpoints with audit logging.

title: [TASK] Implement report submit API with idempotency key
body: Store per-exercise execution facts and wellbeing; prevent duplicate submissions.

title: [TASK] Implement trigger worker and attention queue API
body: Evaluate 3 v1 rules and persist explainable trigger payloads.
